errors.what: Edited the post's front matter while run_workflow_locally was sweeping, which voided portfolio-validate/portfolio-pages; shorts.test.mjs failed in that sweep and passes alone (10/10).
errors.fix: Re-ran portfolio-validate.yml on a still tree.

doc_friction.issue: Step 0's open list held 9 entries, every one a control-plane fix waiting on owner approval; a scheduled run can do nothing with them, but the prompt reads as if it must clear them before seeding. A filter (redteam.py open --actionable) would save the read.
The suggested `git log --since=3.days --name-only origin/main` prints nothing on the shallow clone (depth 1), so it can't pick a recently changed target.

deviations.why: Step 0 asks to fix open entries first; all 9 are control-plane (.github/workflows, prompts/, platform/ci guards) needing an owner-approved PR.
deviations.did: Left them untouched and seeded faults.
deviations.result: The run spent its time on product defects instead (3 found, 3 fixed).

deviations.why: Step 4b prefers a repo-wide lint for the class. A '40-hex' lint would be mostly false positives, because GitHub action and PR SHAs are rightly SHA-1 only.
deviations.did: Swept the 15 such patterns by hand and fixed the one that parses raw git output (git-exposure-check); the rest are GitHub-SHA checks.
deviations.result: One sibling defect fixed; no lint added.

notes: Campaigns: git-timesheet/usage.mjs 8/8 caught (random draw); engine.mjs 6/10 caught, 4 gaps -> tests, 10/10 after. Guard added: per-product tests only; the class check was a manual sweep of 40-hex regexes (ventures/requirements-pin-check's VCS @sha pin would read a 64-hex pin as unpinned, which errs on the safe side, so it was left). Local checks: run_venture_tests git-timesheet + git-exposure-check: 101 tests ok; run_workflow_locally --for-changes: see PR. run_workflow_locally --for-changes: ventures-tests, pages, doc-refs, page-integrity, link-contrast, sibling-links and others green; portfolio-validate re-run after a post front-matter fix (description 168>160 chars); agent-cross-review and deploy jobs can't run locally.

real_defects.issue: parseLog accepted hashes of 4-40 hex only, so a SHA-256 repository (git init --object-format=sha256, %H is 64 hex) had every line rejected: the CLI exited 2 'no commits parsed' and the page showed nothing. Reproduced with a real sha256 repo. Fixed: {4,64}, with a test.

gate() skipped --max-amount when no --rate was given (amount null), so `cli.mjs --max-amount 1` exited 0 'within limits': a CI/cron budget gate that can never fire. Fixed: gate fails with '--max-amount N cannot be checked without --rate' (exit 1), with engine and CLI tests.

HEAD_DETACHED_RE accepted only 40 hex, so a detached HEAD from a SHA-256 repository (64 hex) was not recognised: with config also readable the site was downgraded from git-directory-exposed to git-config-exposed; with only HEAD readable the exposure was missed. Found by sweeping for the git-timesheet hash-length class. Fixed: 40 or 64 hex, test first; page copy updated.
